## Summary

Brief description of changes.

## Related Issue

Closes #

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change (for example, a backup format older versions cannot read)
- [ ] Texts or translation
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] `./mvnw clean verify` passes
- [ ] Changes to budgeting rules or storage have tests
- [ ] New user-visible texts are in `strings_ca.properties` (no text in the code)
- [ ] New database changes are a new migration (no released migration was edited)
- [ ] No real personal data in tests, screenshots or examples
- [ ] Conventional Commits followed
- [ ] `MANUAL.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` (*Unreleased*) updated if users see the change
